errors.meaning: Task identity does not exist in current authority.
Task or command-bound current authority revision changed since the reviewed/request context.
Local Task name is missing/blank or outside semantic bounds.
Only one Task-plan endpoint is present.
Operational Task plan end is not strictly later than start.
Ordinary plan replacement is blocked by accepted execution, terminal/protected history or explicit plan lock; use the governed correction path when eligible.
Requested regroup would rewrite protected membership/execution history.
Requested direct Task relationship kind/action or Task-kind combination is invalid; WFM Tasks cannot own direct SR/RFC links.
Selected LLD-03 Service Request, RFC or Device Reference relational identity does not exist.
Task already has a different current Objective membership.
Requested membership removal/move targets a noncurrent relationship.
Task has accepted actual start evidence.
Operation requires accepted Task start evidence.
Task execution/termination evidence is already terminal under current projection.
Cancelled-without-execution cannot be recorded after accepted start evidence.
Requested reviewed outcome contradicts current accepted execution/cancellation evidence.
Outcome/review target changed after review preview.
Predecessor already has a direct retry successor.
Retry relation would create an identity cycle or self-reference.
Reviewed activity-lineage assignment conflicts with immutable retry/attempt evidence.
The WFM activity-review fingerprint or complete touched-lineage authority changed after preview; refresh the review before mutation.
WFM Task No. is not exact TK plus fourteen digits.
Canonical WFM Task No. was retired by an eligible hard-delete correction and cannot be registered or source-adopted again.
Owning RFC is not currently eligible to own active nonterminal WFM work.
Owning RFC identity/hierarchy/lifecycle or WFM assignment authority changed since the reviewed mutation context.

The pending WFM source-terminal review, accepted terminal source projection, or exact SOMA_WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_REVIEW_V1 local-authority fingerprint changed or was superseded; refresh the source-terminal review before deciding a local consequence.
Current protected Task history makes WFM parent reassignment high-risk and requires explicit high-risk acceptance.
More than one overlapping active WFM attempt is currently classified in the same reviewed activity lineage and requires explicit resolution.
Objective identity does not exist.
Objective revision/envelope/membership changed since preview.
A current persisted Objective cannot have zero current Tasks; last-member removal must atomically delete an eligible untouched Objective or be rejected.
Requested accepted Objective envelope would strictly overlap another current accepted Objective outside the reviewed proposal scope.
Terminal/reviewed historical Objective membership cannot be restructured.
Requested in-progress regroup exceeds the limited high-risk operations allowed without rewriting started/protected work.
Current member Tasks do not yet have the required independently reviewed outcomes/evidence for Objective review acceptance.
Membership/outcome fingerprint changed after Objective review preview.
Whole-Objective cancellation is forbidden because at least one member Task has accepted start evidence.
MW-######## allocator reached explicit non-reusable exhaustion sentinel before mutation.
Regroup proposal does not exist.
Material task-plan, membership, lock, objective or overlap state no longer matches the exact proposal fingerprint/revisions.
Exact material grouping inputs match a prior rejection; explicit reconsideration is required before redisplay/acceptance.
Complete overlap/lock/dependency authority could not be established; regroup fails closed.
Provider Complete/source-plan/operational-plan/objective state changed since historical proposal.
Historical Objective structure lacks current provider-Complete evidence, usable accepted operational plan, or unassigned Task eligibility.
Task/Objective has source adoption, execution, review, relationship, retry, archive, Inventory or other protected history.
Required cross-domain deletion dependency could not be proven CLEAR.
Requested Objective scheduling timezone is not resolvable by the packaged IANA database.
Local schedule wall time maps to two instants and explicit fold/offset choice is missing or invalid.
Local schedule wall time falls in a timezone gap and cannot be silently shifted.
A Task hard-delete/retry operation requiring LLD-07 authority cannot proceed until its bounded dependency provider is available.

transport_rule: LLD-01 maps typed domain conflicts to stable error envelopes. Unknown exceptions never serialize entity/source bodies or arbitrary stack/environment data to clients or audit payloads.
